title: Oct 3 Results + Oct 4 Preview: Three Out of Four Ain't Bad
summary: Model goes 3-1 on Oct 3 slate. Brewers back in the spotlight for Oct 4.

content.value:
## Another Solid Day in the Books

You know, I've been doing this long enough to tell you that a 3-1 day is exactly what you're looking for over the long haul. Sure, we missed on the Guardians pick—and at 52% confidence, that one was always going to be a coin flip—but the model locked in on three winners when it mattered. That's the kind of consistency that pays the bills.

## How the Day Unfolded

The Dodgers pick at 65% was our most confident call, and they delivered as expected. The Rays and Brewers both came through in closer contests—those 53-59% range picks that separate good models from mediocre ones. The Sox-Guardians game? That's baseball. When you're barely above 50%, you accept the losses and move on.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick Preview

Well, well, well—look who's back on the docket. The Padres and Brewers rematch is our top pick for October 4th, and once again we're riding with Milwaukee. Now, I'll be straight with you: at exactly 50%, this is essentially a toss-up. But there's context here that matters.

content.title: ⭐ Oct 4 Top Pick
content.value: Milwaukee Brewers over San Diego Padres
content.sub: 50% Win Probability • Logan Henderson vs Michael King

content.value:
## The Pitching Matchup

Logan Henderson takes the ball for Milwaukee against Michael King for San Diego. I've seen this kind of matchup a thousand times—two competitive clubs, decent arms on both sides, and the home field advantage becoming the deciding factor. King has been solid for the Padres, no question, but Henderson at home in Milwaukee has quietly been effective when given run support.

The 50% number tells you everything: this game could go either way. But when things are even, I lean on home field, and I lean on recent momentum. The Brewers just took yesterday's game in this same building, and there's something to be said for carrying that energy into the next day.

Don't bet the house on this one, folks. But if you're looking for a pick tomorrow, Milwaukee's got just enough edge to warrant the nod.
